label: GO after unrewarded S1 visit (a1 >> a2), boosted by a prior loss and late episode
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
explanation: Fires only at GO (zero at D1 and D2). Magnitude is set by the previous trial: by far the largest after a1 -> S1 unrewarded (common, unrewarded; residual about +1.4), much weaker after a2 -> S1 unrewarded (rare, unrewarded; about +0.2), and slightly below baseline after every other pattern, including all rewarded trials and unrewarded S2 visits. Within a1 S1 u it grows when the trial before was unrewarded too (+0.7) and grows with episode decile (+0.17 per decile, on top of the GO timing ramp). a2 S1 u gets the same kind of boost from a prior loss (+0.4). All terms are observed-only. Choice, state, value, hidden good state and future variables add essentially nothing; |policy| and an unrewarded S1 visit two trials back added nothing. Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.65; ceiling all 0.63, all observed 0.61.

issues: The claim that an earlier loss adds +0.49 after a2 S1 u is an average that hides a dependence on what was chosen two trials back. If the trial before was an unrewarded a1 trial (either state), the extra is about +1.85 to +2.0; if it was an unrewarded a2 trial, it is only about +0.3 to +0.45 (test fit with a2 S1 u crossed with each pattern two trials back: +2.01 for a1 S1 u, +1.88 for a1 S2 u, +0.31 for a2 S1 u, +0.45 for a2 S2 u). After a1 S1 u, the loss boost is also largest when the trial before was a1 S1 u (+1.09, against about +0.5 for other losses). The real modulator is 'a recent unrewarded a1 choice', not just any prior loss.
Adding these refinements and a three-loss streak term only raises test R^2 from 0.651 to about 0.67. The original terms already capture most of the explainable variance.

The worst misses are almost all GO steps on the window's first trial or second trial, where earlier history is unknown (prev_state == -1 or tv(...,-2) == -9). Actual values there are 2.4 to 3.7 while predictions are about 0.1 to 0.8. These are long runs of unrewarded a2 trials that reach S1 by a rare transition. This is a window-boundary limit, not a flaw in the label. It does suggest that a long unrewarded streak can push the feature after a2 S1 u up to the a1 S1 u level.

The other claims check out on test. The feature is exactly 0 at D1 and D2. All other previous-trial patterns sit about 0.13 below the timing baseline. The a1 S1 u x ep_dec weight is +0.18. Choice x state, value and the hidden good state each score 0.00. Swapping in policy-logit terms adds under 0.01. Misses show no systematic phase or previous-trial error beyond a uniform -0.1 to -0.11 over-prediction at GO across the patterns that are not S1 u (an intercept effect).
